name: Elaheh Ahmadi
bio: I'm a researcher, entrepreneur, and photographer. My current work at Cisco Foundation AI focuses on recursive self-improvement systems and efficient training of small, specialized models.

Before Cisco, I co-founded VIVA AI, where I built voice AI for dental and medical practices, and Themis AI, an MIT CSAIL spin-out focused on uncertainty and trustworthy AI. I now advise both companies.
My research background spans language modeling, uncertainty quantification, healthcare, and robotics. Alongside research, I make videos explaining AI papers through Papers in Motion.
Outside of AI, I explore photography and visual storytelling.
